title: Speed Card Game
summary: Architected and shipped a fully online 1v1 real-time card game with sub-second response times, Go microservices, a C++ authoritative server, and Terraform-based cloud provisioning.
details: A complete real-time multiplayer card game platform built with modern cloud infrastructure. Features include sub-second latency optimization, containerized microservices, and automated deployment pipelines.
achievements: Designed and implemented Go microservices for player matchmaking and session management
Built C++ authoritative game server for fair play and cheat prevention
Set up Terraform infrastructure for scalable AWS deployment
Achieved sub-second response times with optimized networking

title: Telemetry (UBS)
summary: Designed a RabbitMQ-based notification pipeline, integrated Grafana dashboards, and deployed cloud infrastructure with LSTM anomaly detection alerts.
details: Enterprise observability platform for monitoring and alerting on system anomalies using machine learning. Features real-time dashboards, automated notifications, and predictive anomaly detection.
achievements: Architected RabbitMQ message pipeline for event streaming
Integrated Grafana for real-time metric visualization
Implemented LSTM neural network for anomaly detection
Deployed on AWS with auto-scaling capabilities

title: Cheaty Fetch
summary: Engineered a Python/Selenium scraper to aggregate real-time trading card prices across Singapore retailers, with a caching layer and a React frontend for cross-retailer comparison.
details: Full-stack price comparison tool for trading card collectors. Scrapes multiple retailers in real-time and provides a React interface for easy price comparisons.
achievements: Built Python scraper with Selenium for dynamic content extraction
Implemented efficient caching to reduce request overhead
Created React frontend for intuitive price comparison
Containerized with Docker for easy deployment

title: Urban Farm
summary: Developed a fully functional Android game with a custom multithreaded architecture, concurrent game systems, and a robust local persistence layer.
details: A complete Android game built from the ground up with custom game engine architecture. Features farming simulation, trading mechanics, and local data persistence.
achievements: Designed custom game engine with multithreaded system architecture
Implemented concurrent game state management
Built SQLite persistence layer for save game data
Optimized frame rendering for smooth 60fps gameplay

title: CycleGAN Image Translation
summary: Designed and trained a CycleGAN-based image translation model with architectural optimizations and advanced loss tuning for high-quality style transfer.
details: A deep learning project focused on unpaired image-to-image translation using CycleGAN. Includes architectural improvements, loss engineering, and training optimizations for enhanced visual quality.
achievements: Trained CycleGAN for style transfer (real ↔ cartoon, young ↔ old)
Improved image quality via architectural changes (residual blocks, spectral norm)
Engineered multi-loss training (adversarial, cycle, identity, perceptual)
Optimized training with mixed precision (AMP) and LR scheduling
Reduced GMS score from 5.34 to 4.04 through experimentation

title: Recommendation System
summary: Built a collaborative filtering recommendation system using matrix factorization with bias modeling and clustering for interpretable insights.
details: A recommendation system leveraging matrix factorization to learn latent user-item representations, combined with clustering techniques for interpretability.
achievements: Implemented SVD-based collaborative filtering for recommendations
Added bias-aware modeling to improve RMSE (~1.00)
Trained embedding-based models using PyTorch
Applied KMeans clustering on embeddings for user segmentation
Processed large datasets and visualized training dynamics
